int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    FILE *f = fopen(argv[1], "rb");
    if (!f) return 2;
    char buf[64];
    size_t n = fread(buf, 1, sizeof(buf), f);
    fclose(f);
    printf("n=%zu\n", n);
    if (n > 999) abort();
    puts("ok");
    return 0;
}
